pairs.question: Dic mihi, Damoeta, cuium pecus? An Meliboei?
pairs.answer: Non, verum Aegonos; nuper mihi tradidit Aegon.
pairs.derivation: Menalcas asks Damoetas whose the flock is (interrogative 'cuium pecus? An Meliboei?'); Damoetas answers directly that it is Aegon's. Speaker labels 'Menalcas'/'Damoetas' stripped. Answer is the full single-line reply; no preamble to skip. The remaining poem is an amoebean singing contest of capping statements, boasts, and unanswered riddles (e.g. the 'Dic quibus in terris' challenges at 104-107, which Palaemon declines to judge), so no further genuine Q&A pairs.
